subject.title: Feature proposal: codexbar guard — a quota-aware exit code to gate automation

question: Should CodexBar adopt `guard` as a supported automation-facing CLI contract, and are the proposed exit codes and fail-closed default the intended long-term semantics?
rationale: The capability is additive rather than a broken-contract fix, and VISION.md requires explicit sign-off for new feature surface; implementation review cannot decide the permanent scripting contract by itself.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow MVP
options.body: Accept provider, threshold, session/weekly window, JSON output, and documented 0/1/2 exit semantics, then review the linked PR against that contract.

options.title: Narrow the contract first
options.body: Keep the proposal open but ask the contributor to reduce or revise defaults and flags before the linked implementation proceeds.

options.title: Decline the command surface
options.body: Keep quota reporting passive and close the proposal and linked implementation rather than establishing a new automation API.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow MVP
recommendation.body: Accept provider, threshold, session/weekly window, JSON output, and documented 0/1/2 exit semantics, then review the linked PR against that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner introduced and recently maintained the relevant CLI surface and is explicitly named in the proposal's sign-off request.
